div.div: أَغْيَظُ [comparative and superlative of غَائِظٌ]. أَغْيَظُ الأَسْمَآءِ عِنْدَ ٱللّٰهِ مَلِكُ الأَمْلَاكِ means The most severely to be punished, of persons bearing names, is he who is named the king of kings: (TA:) [lit. the most angering, or enraging, of names, is the king of kings.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
